definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of dividing one number by another.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{算|ざん}で{割合|わりあい}を{計算|けいさん}する。
examples.english: To calculate the ratio using division.

notes:
{割|わ}り{算|ざん} is composed of {割|わ}る (to divide) + {算|さん} (calculation). Used mainly in math education and everyday arithmetic.

HOW TO READ DIVISION:
- 12{割|わ}る3は4: 12 divided by 3 is 4
- The verb {割|わ}る is used for "divided by"

FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS:
- {足|た}し{算|ざん}: addition (+)
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}: subtraction (−)
- {掛|か}け{算|ざん}: multiplication (×)
- {割|わ}り{算|ざん}: division (÷)

RELATED TERMS:
- {割|わ}り{切|き}れる: divisible (no remainder)
- {割|わ}り{切|き}れない: indivisible; also figuratively "hard to accept"
- {余|あま}り: remainder
